name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 11 Local Link Building Strategies
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Ways to earn local backlinks that build authority and geographic relevance.

# Strategies
1. Sponsorships and events (youth sports, charities, festivals) with sponsor pages.
2. Local directories, "shop local" and tourism sites, Chamber of Commerce and trade associations.
3. Local resource content (a "Best of [City]" guide or a helpful "How to choose a [trade] in [City]"), then tell the featured businesses.
4. Relationships with local bloggers and news; press releases for real news (openings, anniversaries, charity work).
5. Existing relationships: suppliers, partners and B2B clients (testimonials with links).
6. Guest posts on relevant local sites, sparingly and with real value (the lesson also promotes Indexsy's paid local guest post packages).

# Milestone
About 5 new quality local links (news, sponsorship, chamber, guest post).

# How this applies to TAG clients
- TAG budgets about $50 per month per client for backlinks through [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas); anything beyond that needs Scott's approval.
- Chambers, supplier pages (for example lining-material manufacturers' installer directories) and real community sponsorships are good fits for trenchless and plumbing clients.
